    • seed

      public CrawlRequest.Builder seed(String url)
      Adds one seed URL, parsed with URI.create(String).

    • seed

      public CrawlRequest.Builder seed(URI url)
      Adds one seed URL.

    • maxDepth

      public CrawlRequest.Builder maxDepth(int maxDepth)
      Sets the greatest depth a fetched URL may have. Default: 3.

    • maxPages

      public CrawlRequest.Builder maxPages(int maxPages)
      Sets the greatest number of unique URLs fetched. Default: 100.

    • sameHostOnly

      public CrawlRequest.Builder sameHostOnly(boolean sameHostOnly)
      Restricts discovered links to the seeds' exact hosts. Default: true.

    • includeSubdomains

      public CrawlRequest.Builder includeSubdomains(boolean includeSubdomains)
      Allows discovered links on true subdomains of an allowed host. Default: false.

    • allowedHost

      public CrawlRequest.Builder allowedHost(String host)
      Adds one host, beyond the seeds, allowed to be followed.

    • allowedSchemes

      public CrawlRequest.Builder allowedSchemes(String... schemes)
      Replaces the allowed schemes. Default: http, https.

    • timeout

      public CrawlRequest.Builder timeout(Duration timeout)
      Sets the per-request timeout. Default: 10 seconds.

    • maxResponseBytes

      public CrawlRequest.Builder maxResponseBytes(long maxResponseBytes)
      Sets the greatest response body size read. Default: 5,000,000 bytes.

    • maxRedirects

      public CrawlRequest.Builder maxRedirects(int maxRedirects)
      Sets the greatest number of redirect hops followed per fetch attempt. Default: 5.

    • retryPolicy

      public CrawlRequest.Builder retryPolicy(RetryPolicy retryPolicy)
      Sets the retry attempt count and backoff. Default: RetryPolicy.defaults().

    • retryableStatusCodes

      public CrawlRequest.Builder retryableStatusCodes(int... statusCodes)
      Replaces the retryable HTTP status codes. Default: 429, 500, 502, 503, 504.

    • retryOnIoException

      public CrawlRequest.Builder retryOnIoException(boolean retryOnIoException)
      Sets whether a network/IO failure is retryable. Default: true.

    • userAgent

      public CrawlRequest.Builder userAgent(String userAgent)
      Sets the User-Agent header. Default: CrawlRequest.DEFAULT_USER_AGENT.

    • defaultHeader

      public CrawlRequest.Builder defaultHeader(String name, String value)
      Adds one default header sent with every request. Never add Authorization or Cookie here unless the caller genuinely intends every request to carry it - neither is added by default.

      name and value are validated against the HTTP/1.1 header grammar by build(), not here - an invalid header is rejected at construction time, never silently accepted at this call.

    • allowedContentTypes

      public CrawlRequest.Builder allowedContentTypes(String... contentTypes)
      Replaces the Content-Type values parsed as HTML. Default: text/html, application/xhtml+xml.

    • traversalStrategy

      public CrawlRequest.Builder traversalStrategy(TraversalStrategy traversalStrategy)
      Sets the frontier's release order. Default: TraversalStrategy.BREADTH_FIRST.

    • queryParameterPolicy

      public CrawlRequest.Builder queryParameterPolicy(QueryParameterPolicy queryParameterPolicy)
      Sets the query-parameter policy. Default: QueryParameterPolicy.keepAll().

    • includeUrlPattern

      public CrawlRequest.Builder includeUrlPattern(String regex)
      Adds one regex a candidate URL must match at least one of to be allowed.

    • excludeUrlPattern

      public CrawlRequest.Builder excludeUrlPattern(String regex)
      Adds one regex that rejects any matching candidate URL.

    • failFast

      public CrawlRequest.Builder failFast(boolean failFast)
      Sets whether one page's terminal failure stops the whole crawl. Default: false - a failed page is recorded and the crawl continues.

    • build

      public CrawlRequest build()
      Builds and validates the CrawlRequest.
